import React, { useEffect } from 'react'; import { useAppContext } from '../context/AppContext'; function Dashboard() { const { scheduler, memory, fileSystem } = useAppContext(); return (

🖥️ CoreX OS Dashboard

{/* Main Grid Layout */}
{/* Top Stats Cards - Row 1 */}
⚡ CPU Utilization
{scheduler.stats.cpu_utilization || 0}%
💾 Memory Hit Ratio
{memory.page_hits && (memory.page_faults + memory.page_hits) > 0 ? ((memory.page_hits / (memory.page_faults + memory.page_hits)) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%
📁 Storage Used
{fileSystem.stats.used_blocks || 0} / {fileSystem.stats.total_blocks || 0}
{/* CPU Scheduler - Row 2, Column 1 */}

⚙️ CPU Scheduler

Algorithm
{scheduler.stats.algorithm || 'N/A'}
Avg Wait
{scheduler.stats.avg_waiting_time || 0} ms
Avg TAT
{scheduler.stats.avg_turnaround_time || 0} ms
Avg Response
{scheduler.stats.avg_response_time || 0} ms
📊 Info: Manages process execution using FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and Priority algorithms for optimal CPU utilization.
{/* Memory Management - Row 2, Column 2 */}

🧠 Memory Management

Algorithm
{memory.algorithm || 'N/A'}
Page Faults
{memory.page_faults || 0}
Page Hits
{stats.memory.page_hits || 0}
Frames Used
{stats.memory.used_frames || 0} / {stats.memory.total_frames || 0}
💡 Info: Implements FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement algorithms with {stats.memory.total_frames || 256} frames for efficient memory usage.
{/* File System Status - Row 2-3, Column 3 */}

📁 File System Status

Total Inodes
{stats.vfs.total_inodes || 0}
Used Inodes
{stats.vfs.used_inodes || 0}
Total Blocks
{stats.vfs.total_blocks || 0}
Block Size
{stats.vfs.block_size || 0}B
🗂️ Info: Virtual File System with hierarchical directory structure supporting file creation, deletion, and navigation operations.
); } export default Dashboard;
